metaData.originalTitle: Agent view in Claude Code | Claude
metaData.title: Agent view in Claude Code | Claude
metaData.oneSentenceSummary: Claude Code introduces agent view, a CLI-based interface for managing multiple concurrent coding sessions, allowing users to background agents, peek at responses, and steer parallel tasks from a single view.
metaData.summary: This article from the official Claude Blog announces the launch of agent view in Claude Code, a new feature designed to streamline the management of multiple parallel coding sessions. It addresses the pain point of juggling multiple terminal tabs and tmux grids by providing a unified CLI interface. Key capabilities include launching new agents, sending them to the background, and receiving notifications only when human input is needed. The interface provides an at-a-glance overview of agent status (waiting, working, done). Users can peek at the last turn of a session and reply inline without fully attaching. The article also highlights early user patterns, such as scaling concurrent sessions, managing long-running agents, and navigating between separate tasks. Agent view is available as a Research Preview for Pro, Max, Team, Enterprise, and API users.
metaData.featuredReason: Claude Code finally stops being a circus act for parallel sessions. Agent View brings every session into one CLI dashboard — who needs your input, who's still working, who's already shipping PRs. Launch directly to background with `claude --bg [task]`, hit the left arrow to return to the overview, use `/bg` to push any foreground session back. It's the key step toward managing a dozen agents at once and sets the interaction baseline for multi-agent collaboration.

mainPoints.point: Agent view provides a single CLI interface to manage all Claude Code sessions.
mainPoints.explanation: It replaces the need for multiple terminal tabs or tmux grids by showing all active, waiting, and completed agents in one list, improving oversight and navigation.

mainPoints.point: Users can background agents and interact with them asynchronously.
mainPoints.explanation: The `/bg` command or `claude --bg` flag allows launching tasks that run in the background, with users only needing to jump in when an agent requires a decision.

mainPoints.point: The feature enables scaling concurrent coding tasks and managing long-running processes.
mainPoints.explanation: Early users are dispatching multiple ideas simultaneously, managing PR babysitters and dashboard updaters, and easily navigating between separate sessions for quick questions.

keyQuotes: With agent view in Claude Code, you can kick off new agents, send them to the background, and jump in only when Claude needs you.
See at a glance which agents are waiting on you, which are still working, and which are done, so you can easily steer many all at once.
Dispatch several ideas at once, each optionally paired with a skill, and return to a list of pull requests ready for review.
